title: Treatise on the Trapping Fork
summary: Teaches the use of the trident's fork to snare weapons and feet with ground rings of qi.

title: Canon of Qi-Driven Prongs
summary: Sets out how a Xiantian student drives qi through each prong to lance and to ward.

title: Casting and Recovery of the Trident
summary: Teaches throwing the trident and drawing it back to the hand on a thread of qi.

title: A Treatise on Three-Point Pressure
summary: Builds sustained qi pressure through all three tines until a braced guard gives way.

title: Paired Prong and River Haft
summary: Teaches matched outer-tine strikes and a flowing haft guard in the paired manner of the basin schools.

title: The Azure Fork of the Two Currents
summary: A Xiantian treatise running two currents of qi down the haft and meeting them at the fork's point.

title: Hawk-Talon Trident Discourse
summary: Teaches stooping dives and talon-like seizing with the outer tines in the manner of the hawk.

title: Wind-Sworn Trident Bearings
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student to hold a sworn bearing and let the wind carry each thrust.

title: Oath of the Three Points
summary: Binds each of the three tines to a pledged line of attack and guard for a Champion student.

title: The Open-Wind Fork Treatise
summary: A treatise on fighting with the fork in open wind where no wall stands to shelter behind.
